reviews.title: There are many major inconveniences with this application, PLEASE TAKE THIS REVIEW SERIOUSLY.
reviews.text:
Your application has potential, but there are several important issues that need immediate attention, especially for users paying for the premium subscription.

I paid $39.99 for the yearly premium plan mainly because the widget feature looked useful, but after using the app, I found lots of issues.

1. The prayer times shown in the app are incorrect, and there is currently no option to adjust the calculation method or manually correct the timings. For an app that relies heavily on accurate prayer schedules, this should be a basic feature available from the start.

2. The widget displays prayer times in 24 hour format with no option to switch to standard 12 hour time. Users should be able to choose the time format that works best for them instead of being forced into one option.

3. The AI assistant should be able to guide users through app settings, explain features, and help troubleshoot issues. Right now, it doesn’t seem knowledgeable enough about the app itself to be truly useful, its just ChatGPT dressed up as “Deen Buddy”

These are not minor inconveniences, they are ESSENTIAL features, especially considering this is a paid subscription. The most concerning issue is the inability to correct prayer times, because accurate adhan timing is one of the main reasons users download and pay for an app like this.

Please take this feedback seriously and improve these areas. At $39.99 per year, users expect the app to deliver accurate functionality and meaningful customization op
